bank_allocations_undo_chk.name: bank_allocations_undo_chk
bank_allocations_undo_chk.value: ("bank_allocations"."status" = 'desfeita' and "bank_allocations"."undone_by" is not null and "bank_allocations"."undone_at" is not null and "bank_allocations"."undo_reason" is not null) or ("bank_allocations"."status" = 'ativa' and "bank_allocations"."undone_by" is null and "bank_allocations"."undone_at" is null and "bank_allocations"."undo_reason" is null)

billing_batches_approval_chk.name: billing_batches_approval_chk
billing_batches_approval_chk.value: ("billing_batches"."status" = 'aprovado') = ("billing_batches"."approved_by" is not null and "billing_batches"."approved_at" is not null)

issuance_requests_done_chk.name: issuance_requests_done_chk
issuance_requests_done_chk.value: "issuance_requests"."status" not in ('emitido', 'processando') or "issuance_requests"."external_ref" is not null

messaging_settings_limits_chk.name: messaging_settings_limits_chk
messaging_settings_limits_chk.value: "messaging_settings"."max_per_run" between 1 and 500 and "messaging_settings"."max_per_hour" between 1 and 2000 and "messaging_settings"."max_late_days" between 0 and 30

payments_reversal_chk.name: payments_reversal_chk
payments_reversal_chk.value: ("payments"."status" = 'estornado' and "payments"."reversed_by" is not null and "payments"."reversed_at" is not null and "payments"."reverse_reason" is not null) or ("payments"."status" = 'ativo' and "payments"."reversed_by" is null and "payments"."reversed_at" is null and "payments"."reverse_reason" is null)
